specification.selection_reason: The old failed plan test used 20 sweeps, an all-streets tree with 59,448 plan records and an unmet quality target. The new independently verified grouped flop-checkdown game has 1,300 public states, 108 grouped world rows and 1,744 information sets; 1,000 sweeps pass quality. Reuse the unchanged helper to test a materially different compilation/storage amortization regime. Preserve the old negative report; no candidate modification or post-hoc retry.
specification.gate: Research evidence only: exact full payload SHA across all six timed arms and separately both allocation arms; every timed arm meets unchanged quality; candidate faster in all three pairs; median paired reduction at least 5%; candidate separate traced peak <=1.01x baseline. Production integration still requires independent versioned plan work/allocation admission.
specification.scope: Fixed four-combo-per-seat, four-selected-flop, 10-chip heads-up preflop/flop game with forced future checkdown. No shared source edits, dependencies, third-party source or Coach work. Standalone prototype caps do not replace production admission.

failures: candidate was not faster in every paired timing arm
admission_scope: Standalone prototype record/reference caps apply before compilation; existing production vector_work_budget does not charge prototype census, compilation, retained records or partition/conversion overlap. No production integration is authorized by this experiment gate. A separate independent versioned workload/allocation envelope is required before any adoption. No existing cap is relaxed.
timing_scope: Three alternating complete solves plus JSON, including first-call census/compile and plan release. Patch contexts, runout preparation and GC precede timing. Plan is retained through final diagnostics/JSON. Independent original-world replay follows timing. Policies are released between arms.
allocation_scope: Separate 10/delay5 complete calls plus JSON and plan release under tracemalloc. These are Python-traced allocations, not RSS or high-iteration memory. Target misses remain visible.
interpretation: New fixed grouped flop-checkdown workload, not a rerun or replacement of the earlier failed 20-sweep all-streets plan test. Exact full payload parity, independent legal best responses, all-three-pair direction, 5% median reduction and separate 1.01x peak gate are required. No general speedup or full-game convergence claim.
model_limits: Finite conditioned heads-up preflop/flop game with four weighted exact combos per player, four selected flops, 9,408 ordered future candidates, 91,080 compatible physical worlds, forced flop checkdown, and one shared 10-chip stack. Not full-deck preflop, turn/river betting, multiway or unrestricted NLHE; no general convergence claim.
